app.name: YanJing
盐筋
盐筋
saved.hint: Tap the bookmark on a passage to keep the original text and its reference offline.
点击经文旁的收藏图标，即可在本机保存原文与出处。
version.offline: All texts and search resources are included. No download or account is needed.
全文与检索资源均已内置，无需下载或登录。
search.hero:
用今天的话，
找到经典原句。
search.subtitle: Search original texts, explore related meanings, and read the context.
描述意思、搜索原文，也读它的上下文。
search.private: 完全离线 · 无需登录
search.prompt: 输入句意、关键词或出处
search.emptyHint: Try a specific keyword or a reference such as John 3:16. Meaning search works primarily with Chinese queries.
试试更具体的关键词，或输入“约 3:16”等出处。句意模型主要支持中文查询。
search.resultHint: Related meaning is a search aid, not an interpretation or a probability. Read the original passage in context.
句意相近只辅助查找，不代表释义准确，也不是概率。请结合上下文阅读原文。
search.limits: Meaning search uses a local Chinese BGE model. English interface support does not make this model multilingual. For English text, use Original text or a reference. Classical glosses are modern Chinese search aids, not full translations or authoritative commentary.
句意搜索使用本地中文 BGE 模型。界面语言与模型能力独立；英语原文请使用原文搜索或出处。经典白话释义仅辅助查找，不是完整翻译或权威注疏。
search.semanticUnavailable: Meaning search is unavailable. Results from other selected modes remain available; you can also use a reference.
句意搜索暂不可用，仍可使用其他已选模式或出处查找。
search.modeHint: Keep at least one mode selected. Queries stay on this device.
至少保留一种搜索模式，查询只在本机处理。
mode.semantic.hint: Find related passages using a local Chinese model
用本地中文模型查找句意相近的原文
mode.expression.hint: Common expressions, wording and search glosses
结合常用说法、相近用词与检索释义
mode.keyword.hint: 查找原文用词，忽略标点并支持简繁体
reader.hint: Tap any passage to save, share or explore its context. Numbering follows the bundled source edition.
点击任意经文可收藏、分享并查看上下文。篇章与段落编号依所附版本。
detail.title: Passage details
经文详情
detail.glossHint: Project-authored search aid, not a full translation or authoritative commentary.
项目编写的查找辅助，不是完整翻译或权威注疏。
detail.numbering: Translations can divide passages differently. Latin comparisons use the bundled CrossWire mapping, not identical verse numbers.
不同译本的分节可能不同。拉丁文对照使用所附 CrossWire 映射，不能按相同编号机械对应。
detail.noCorrespondence: No mapped passage in this version. Read the original and its context.
此版未附对应分节，请阅读原文与上下文。
settings.tagline: 日常表达 × 经典探索
settings.native: 原生 iOS · 离线检索
language.hint: Changes the interface immediately. Original passages and text versions remain independent.
立即更改界面语言；经典原文和文本版本可独立选择。
settings.sample: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
你的话是我脚前的灯，是我路上的光。
settings.privacy: Texts, models, searches, bookmarks and reading progress stay on this device. YanJing has no account, ads or analytics. The GitHub link opens externally only when you choose it.
文本、模型、查询、收藏与阅读进度均保存在本机。无需账号，无广告和统计追踪；仅在你点击 GitHub 链接时由系统打开外部网页。
settings.sideload: This build is distributed for sideloading. Updates are installed using your sideload tool.
此构建通过侧载分发，更新请使用你的侧载工具安装。
history.confirm: Delete searches stored on this device?
删除本机保存的搜索记录？
error.library: Unable to open the offline text library. Please retry.
无法读取离线文本库，请重试。
error.queryLength: 请输入 200 字以内的内容。
devotions.title: Devotions
读经
devotions.subtitle: Rosary · Prayers
玫瑰经 · 常用祷词
devotions.prayersHint: Twelve prayers for the Rosary and daily life
玫瑰经与日常生活中的十二篇祷词
devotions.completeHint: Rest for a moment in silence. Your place is saved on this device.
可以静默片刻。本次进度已保存在本机。
devotions.restartHint: This resets the saved progress for this set of mysteries.
将重置这一组五端的诵念进度。
devotions.optional: Optional prayer · You may continue to the next step
可选祷词 · 可直接前往下一步
